## Interpretation

The chart shows how confidence can improve as a learner repeats a workflow:
create a file, render it, inspect the result, fix issues, and publish the finished output.
Even a small visualization can make a written reflection easier to understand because the reader can scan the trend immediately.

## Design Notes

A useful chart should have:

- A clear title.
- Labels that explain what the values mean.
- A scale that does not exaggerate the message.
- A short written interpretation beside the visual.
